claims.statement: The tested MXJO 35A 2500mAh sample was a yellow, flat-top, unprotected 18650 wrapper; independent testing rated that sample at 20A rather than the printed 35A, and did not establish the underlying OEM cell.
Steam Engine preserves MXJO IMR 18650 35A 2500mAh 20A as a 2500mAh preset with a 20A runtime rating.
Battery Mooch assessed this tested exact model at 20A continuous discharge.

The MXJO IMR 18650 35A catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry MXJO IMR 18650 35A has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-09-02 or earlier.
